race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
race.verdict: MARHABA YA TAYIB can prove to be a bargain buy for new connections with the form of his Kempton win looking better now than it did at the time. Maliqui and Star Bayside Boy were big eye-catchers last time so rate the main threats. MARHABA YA TAYIB (IRE) MALIQUI (IRE) STAR BAYSIDE BOY (IRE)
